physicalDetails.detail: Old scar along his jaw that he scratches when thinking. Brow draws down when reading a trail.

Carries a bow (arrow nocked, rides with it across the saddle); rides a horse whose bit chimes; keeps his horse a half-length behind Sylvanas's mare's shoulder, 'the same half-length back he always rode'.

voiceMarkers.detail: Dry, teasing, courteous banter: 'Clean.', 'He slipped into your arrow. I watched him do it.', 'Shall I tell the chamber the Ranger-General has gone into stone-reading?'
Uses precise bureaucratic detail as a jab ('It said stable in three different hands', 'He'll bring a clerk', 'prepared figures').
Laughs quietly. Drops the teasing for 'Sylvanas' when serious.

beliefs.belief: If a ward is wrong, it is the magisters' work; write it up and he will carry it in.
beliefs.trueOrFalse: Reasonable but likely insufficient: the formal channel has already failed (three 'stable' hands).

beliefs.belief: He is better liked than Sylvanas by the Convocation because he does not make them look at the map.
beliefs.trueOrFalse: Self-aware political judgement; presented as accurate.

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Take the patrol north, collect the others off the ridge, and face the Convocation budget session in Sylvanas's place.
goalsAtChapterEnd.underlying: Keep Sylvanas steady and informed; get word of what the prisoner is.

emotionalStateAtChapterEnd.state: Wry and concerned. Noticed her fist and the way she looked at her hand; accepts the burden of the Convocation without complaint.

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Orders the Amani bodies burned before something with a nose finds them.
Lets Sylvanas stall by going south to the stones, while pointing out the Convocation will not wait.
Offers to carry the stone report into the chamber with the rest.
Takes the patrol north to Silvermoon and the chamber, and will say Sylvanas was 'called off by something with teeth'; asks her to send word when she knows what the prisoner is.

abilitiesDemonstrated.ability: Capable archer, ready to take the shot if Sylvanas missed; commands the patrol in her absence.
Reads Sylvanas's moods and evasions precisely.

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Leans on the saddle horn when amused; scratches along the jaw scar; squints south through trees.
Laid his own bare palm on the stone and felt nothing ('Feels like a stone to me') but later watches Sylvanas's fisted hand closely.
Raises his arm in farewell and turns his horse.

knowledge.detail: Knows the magisters' wardens rode the southern track in spring and reported 'stable' in three hands; read the report.
Knows Sylvanas found the stone 'off'; does not know about the map or the circled stone.
Heard the runner's report: human mage, through the ring unfelt, 'the leylines are wrong'.

backstory.detail: Long history with Sylvanas; the two ride together and she can take his needling without slowing down. He is 'never had the hand for' reading stones.

arc.currentPosition: Handling politics in Silvermoon while Sylvanas works the border; carries her warning north.
